'''Darth Atroph''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Atroph's son, Lord [[Atren]], was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Freeing" />
